name: research-dev-orchestrator
description: Evidence-backed orchestration with strict, auditable validation for research and lightweight workflows elsewhere.

interface.shortDescription: Plan, parallelize, verify, and safely integrate complex work.
interface.longDescription: Provides reusable Codex workflows for research, machine-learning experiments, web and app delivery, and job-search support. Research tasks receive strict leakage, reproducibility, claim-evidence, and independent-review gates; ordinary work remains lightweight.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Research Dev Orchestrator with evidence, review gates, and explicit approval boundaries.
